name: JAKS
recent: JAKS Resources 正在推进最多 10% 已发行股份的私募配售，并已向 Bursa Securities 提交额外上市申请。公司同时就拟以 RM15.00 million 现金出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal 全部股权及 SAMSB 偿还最多 RM40.00 million 欠款一事，将先决条件期限延长至 2027 年 3 月 31 日。最新季度（截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日）营收为 RM17.74 million。
notable: 并由 SAMSB 偿还最多 RM40.00 million 欠款。
上述出售事项的先决条件期限延长至 2027 年 3 月 31 日，完成日期延至 2027 年 5 月 31 日或之前。
risks: 私募配售最多 10% 新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
公司涉及重大诉讼（MATERIAL LITIGATION）。
出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal 事项的先决条件期限已延长，完成日期延后。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM11.15 million，环比增长 19.8%，同比减少 7.8%；净利为 RM13.06 million，环比减少 22.9%，同比增长 30.9%，净利率为 117.1%。

recent_en: JAKS Resources is proceeding with a private placement of up to 10% of its issued shares and has submitted the additional listing application to Bursa Securities. The company also extended the conditions precedent period to 31 March 2027 for the proposed disposal of its entire stake in JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal for RM15.00 million cash and settlement by SAMSB of up to RM40.00 million owed to JAKS. Latest quarterly revenue for the period ended 30 September 2026 was RM17.74 million.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% of issued shares at an issue price to be determined.
Proposed disposal of entire equity interest in JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal for RM15.00 million cash, with SAMSB to settle up to RM40.00 million owed to JAKS.
Conditions precedent period for the disposal extended to 31 March 2027, with completion extended to on or before 31 May 2027.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
The company is involved in material litigation.
The conditions precedent period for the disposal of JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal has been extended, delaying completion.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM11.15 million, up 19.8% qoq and down 7.8% yoy; net income was RM13.06 million, down 22.9% qoq and up 30.9% yoy, with a net margin of 117.1%.
